styles.sprite: Single video-game sprite asset. Clean stylized 3D render, soft neutral studio lighting, matte materials, gentle ambient occlusion, no blown-out speculars. Fixed camera: high three-quarter view, about 55 degrees above the horizon, looking down at the object. The object is centred, fills roughly 85% of the frame, and is completely isolated on a flat, uniform, pure saturated green (#00FF00) background. Absolutely no cast shadow, no ground plane, no reflection, no vignette, no text, no watermark, no logo, no brand mark, no packaging. Bold chunky silhouette with strong internal value contrast — this asset is displayed at roughly 48 pixels tall, so no fine detail, no thin lines, no small text, no busy texture.
styles.tile: Seamlessly tileable texture swatch, flat orthographic top-down view, perfectly even lighting edge to edge, no vignette, no directional shadow, no perspective. The pattern must repeat continuously with no visible seam when tiled left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Clean stylized game texture with matte simplified materials — not photographic, no photo grain, no camera artefacts. Bright and lightly saturated, readable when scaled down. No text, no watermark, no logo, no objects sitting on the surface.
styles.layer: Wide background layer for a stylized video game, in exactly the same art style as the game's props: clean stylized 3D render, matte materials, soft ambient occlusion, simple chunky forms, no fine detail. Explicitly NOT photographic and NOT a realistic matte painting — no photo texture, no photo grain, no lens flare, no vignette, no depth-of-field blur, no camera artefacts. Bright open midday daylight, high key, clear saturated colours and a genuinely blue sky. Even exposure across the whole frame. No text, no watermark, no logo, no airline branding, no people.
